October 23, 1932

Subject (in full) Departure from Shanghai of members of the Japanese Peerage.

Made by D.P.S. Pitts.    Forwarded by [签名] S.I.

At 9 a.m. October 23, 1932, twelve of the thirteen members
of the Japanese Peerage, who arrived in Shanghai on October
21 on a sightseeing trip, left this city for Japan by the
s.s. "Nagasaki Maru" from Wayside Wharf.
Their departure was without incident.
The thirteenth member of the party, Viscount T. Inouye,
ex-Vice Minister of Navy, is still remaining at the Astor
House, and no details as to his future movements can at
present be obtained.
Protection to the distinguished party was afforded by
members of Wayside Station and D.P.S. Pitts, D.S. Umemoto
and D.C. Imamura of the Special Branch.

[签名]
D.P.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

[左侧批注：JR]

主题（全称）日本贵族院成员离开上海。

由警司皮茨（D.P.S. Pitts）撰写。    由 [签名] 高级督察转发。

1932年10月23日上午9时，于10月21日抵沪进行观光旅行的十三名日本贵族院成员中的十二人，从外摆渡码头（Wayside Wharf）乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船（s.s. "Nagasaki Maru"）离开本市前往日本。
他们的离去未发生任何事件。
该团第十三名成员、前海军次官井上T子爵（Viscount T. Inouye）仍留在礼查饭店（Astor House），目前无法获取其未来动向的详细情况。
外摆渡巡捕房成员以及特别处的警司皮茨（D.P.S. Pitts）、副巡官梅本（D.S. Umemoto）和巡长今村（D.C. Imamura）为该显要团体提供了护卫。

[签名]
警司。

特别处主管警官。

[左侧批注：JR]
[签名]

Made by D.P.S. Pitts. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕**

/3
At 3 p.m. October 21, 1932, the 15 undermentioned members
of the Japanese House of Lords arrived in Shanghai by the
s.s. "Dairen Maru" from Dairen.
Disembarking from the steamer, they made a sightsee-
ing trip up the Whangpoo as far as the Kiangnan Dock, re-
turning to the Customs Jetty, where they arrived at 4.15 p.m.
From here, eight of the members were driven to the
Astor House, whilst five proceeded to the Hoyokan Hotel,
Haining Road.
At 6 p.m. both parties convened at the Astor House
and made their way to the residence of the Japanese Consul-
General at 15 Seymour Road, where a dinner party was held.
This broke-up a little after 10 p.m., the two parties
returning to their respective hotels without incident.
Rooms Nos. 311, 312, 315 on the second floor and Nos.
320, 322, 325, 326 and 327 on the third floor were assigned
to the members of the party staying at the Astor House.
Details of accomodation arrangements at the Hoyokan Hotel
are not available.

主题（全称）十五名日本贵族院成员抵达上海。
由警司皮茨（D.P.S. Pitts）撰写。由 **〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕** 转发。

/3
1932年10月21日下午3时，下述十五名日本贵族院成员乘坐从大连驶来的“大连丸”号轮船（s.s. "Dairen Maru"）抵达上海。
下船后，他们沿黄浦江进行观光游览，直至江南船坞，随后返回海关码头，于下午4时15分抵达。
从这里，八名成员乘车前往礼查饭店（Astor House），而五名成员则前往海宁路的宝屋旅馆（Hoyokan Hotel）。
下午6时，两批人员在礼查饭店汇合，并前往西摩路15号的日本总领事官邸参加晚宴。
晚宴在晚上10点后不久结束，两批人员各自返回酒店，途中未发生任何事件。
礼查饭店二楼的311、312、315号房间以及三楼的320、322、325、326和327号房间分配给了入住该酒店的团成员。
宝屋旅馆的住宿安排详情暂无。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.______
Special Branch S.I. Section,
REPORT
Date October 21, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Arrival in Shanghai of Thirteen Members of the Japanese House of Peers.

Made by D.G. Innes. Forwarded by [Signature]

The undermentioned 13 members of the Japanese House of Peers, who have recently completed a tour of inspection in Manchuria, will arrive in Shanghai en route to Japan from Dairen by the s.s. "Dairen Maru," which is scheduled to berth at the D.K.A. Wharves Pier at about 2.30 p.m. October 21:-

Viscount T. Inouye, leader of the party,
ex-Vice Minister of the Navy.
" Nishioji.
" Tatsumi.
" Iyezono.
Baron Yabuki, ex-Vice Minister of the Navy.
" Matsudaira, ex-Chief of the Administrative Bureau of Saitama Prefecture.
Mr. Yamanouchi, ex-Minister of the Communications.
Mr. Akoke, ex-Commissioner of the Metropolitan Police Board.
Mr. Imai.
Mr. Asamura.
Mr. Awoki.
Mr. Seko.
Mr. Uchida.

They will leave for Japan by the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru" on October 24, and during their sojourn here will reside at the Hoyo Ken Hotel, No.1 Haining Road.

The following programme has been arranged in their honour by the Japanese Consular Authorities:-

October 21, at 6.30 p.m. Reception at the residence of the Japanese Consul-General, No.15 Seymour Road.

主题（全称）十三名日本贵族院成员抵达上海。

由 D.G. Innes 撰写。由 [签名] 转发。

下述十三名日本贵族院成员最近在满洲完成视察之旅，将从大连乘坐“大连丸”号轮船途经上海前往日本，该轮预计于1932年10月21日下午2时30分左右停靠在公和祥码头（D.K.A. Wharves Pier）：-

井上T子爵，团长，
前海军次官。
西尾寺子爵。
辰巳子爵。
家苑子爵。
矢吹男爵，前海军次官。
松平男爵，前埼玉县行政局长。
山内先生，前递信大臣。
赤毛先生，前警视厅总监。
今井先生。
浅村先生。
青木先生。
世古先生。
内田先生。

他们将于10月24日乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船前往日本，在此期间将居住在海宁路1号的宝屋旅馆（Hoyo Ken Hotel）。

日本领事当局已为他们安排了以下日程：-

10月21日，下午6时30分。在西摩路15号日本总领事官邸举行招待会。
